B.Tech. IV Semester Supplementary Examinations, December 2025 / January 2026
Discrete Mathematics
(Common to CSE, IT and CSM)

Time: 3 Hours Answer ALL Questions Max. Marks: 60
Part-A (10 x I= 10 Marks)

What are well formed formulas?

Define CNF.

What is the difference between a subset and a proper subset?
Give an example of a Bijective function.

Define Algebraic system.

How do we denote Boolean algebra?

Define permutation.

How many 10 digit numbers are there with exactly six 1’s?
Define order and size of a Graph.

What is the chromatic number of a graph?

Part-B (5 x 10 = 50 Marks

Show that ((P V Q) A= (FP A (QV -=R))) V GP A -Q) V CP A=
R) is a tautology.
Prove that 4x M(x) follows logically from the premises (x) (H(x) — M(x))
and 4x H(x).

OR
Obtain PDNF for (-P > R) A(Q@P).
Define Predicate. Discuss about Free and Bound variables with
examples.

Let A= {1,2,3,4}, B= {3,4,5,6}, C= {1,3,5}
Find: a) AUB, b) ANB, c)(AUB)NC, d)(AUBUC), e) (ANBNMC).
Define Binary operation. Discuss some general properties of Binary
operations.

OR
Draw Hasse diagram for [Ij2, |].
State and explain about any four frequently used Primitive Recursive
Functions.

Discuss about Homomorphism of Semigroups and Monoids.
Prove that in any lattice (L,V,A), the following identity holds:
aV(aAb)=a and aA(aVb)=a.

OR
Give an example of an algebraic system that is associative but not
commutative. Prove both properties using examples.
Describe the concepts Subalgebra and Direct Product.
